deadline.intake: Fall 2027 first-year admission (Early Action 1 Oct 2026 - 1 Feb 2027; rolling admission 2 Feb - 31 Jul 2027)

tuition.note: Two semesters at EUR 11,925 each, 2027-2028 bachelor programmes (on campus); may be reduced by financing options

requirement.text: SAT/ACT scores are not required for admission evaluation, but enrolment may need a standardized test if the high school diploma does not grant direct admission to a German university; applicants submit their high school diploma and final grades.
